shared_elements: figures with arms raised/extended toward a central object
central focal motif flanked by figures
dense horizontal bands of script filling the lower portion
figural scene set above the inscription
justification: Both surfaces place a figural scene in which profile human figures extend their arms toward a central focal object (a stylised plant in A, an offering stand beneath a rayed disc in B) above a large block of dense, ruled lines of script, which is a real but broadly generic compositional correspondence. The depicted content otherwise diverges sharply: A shows massive bearded, multi-winged composite beings symmetrically flanking a stylised branching tree, while B shows slender elongated crowned figures with attendants beneath a rayed sun disc, and the rendering conventions (muscled, heavily feathered, deeply modelled versus flat, attenuated, purely linear) share nothing distinctive.
